reference: They had the kitchen filmed while they built the rainbow plate.
sk: Kuchyňu si dali natočiť, kým skladali ten dúhový tanier.
cz: Kuchyni si dali natočit, zatímco skládali ten duhový talíř.
acceptable: They {had|got} the kitchen filmed while they {built|were building|assembled|were assembling|put together|were putting together} {the|that} rainbow plate.
{While they built|While they were building|While they were assembling|While they were putting together} {the|that} rainbow plate, they {had|got} the kitchen filmed.

mistakes.text: They filmed the kitchen while they {built|were building} the rainbow plate.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Filmed the kitchen“ znamená, že natáčali sami. „Dali natočiť“ je „had the kitchen filmed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Filmed the kitchen“ znamená, že natáčeli sami. „Dali natočit“ je „had the kitchen filmed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Filmed the kitchen” means they did it themselves; use “had the kitchen filmed”.

mistakes.text: They had filmed the kitchen while they {built|were building} the rainbow plate.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Toto je Past Perfect. Causative má poradie „had + vec + tretí tvar“: „had the kitchen filmed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Tohle je Past Perfect. Causative má pořadí „had + věc + příčestí“: „had the kitchen filmed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: That is the Past Perfect. The causative order is “had + object + past participle”: “had the kitchen filmed”.

mistakes.text: They had the kitchen film while they {built|were building} the rainbow plate.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V Causative patrí za predmet tretí tvar: „filmed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V Causative patří za předmět příčestí minulé: „filmed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In the causative the object is followed by the past participle: “filmed”.

mistakes.text: They gave the kitchen to film while they {built|were building} the rainbow plate.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Dali natočiť“ nie je „gave“. Použi Causative: „had the kitchen filmed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Dali natočit“ není „gave“. Použij Causative: „had the kitchen filmed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Don't use “gave” here. Use the causative: “had the kitchen filmed”.

mistakes.text: They had the kitchen filmed until they built the rainbow plate.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Kým“ tu znamená počas toho, teda „while“. „Until“ znamená až dovtedy, kým.
mistakes.feedback_en: Here the meaning is “during that time”, so use “while”; “until” means up to that moment.

source_issues: Slovak/Czech 'skladali/skládali' means 'were assembling/putting together'; those verbs are accepted besides 'built'.
